[message_id=681853 author=Andreas Bisiadis first=True]
Since in AIMO3 participants could not use Internet with the H100 selected, is this the case in this competition as well?

[message_id=3422394 author=Dustin first=False]
Correct, internet access is disabled on this accelerator for similar reasons to the previous comps.

[message_id=3422948 author=Mani Ratan first=False]
Hii buddy, In most Kaggle competitions, internet access is disabled during submission runs, regardless of the accelerator (like RTX PRO 6000 or H100).
So even if you select a GPU, you usually won’t be able to access external APIs or download data during inference. Everything needed must be included in the notebook or dataset beforehand.
It’s always best to double-check the competition rules page, but in general, assume no internet access during submission. 
I hope it will help you👍
